description: This file implements a Windows-specific clipboard handler using ctypes, providing methods to get and set clipboard text data on Windows platforms.

classes.name: ClipboardWindows
classes.description: A class implementing clipboard operations for Windows using ctypes, including methods to copy, get, and put text data.

methods.name: _copy
methods.description: Copies data to the Windows clipboard.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves text data from the Windows clipboard.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Sets text data to the Windows clipboard.

methods.name: get_types
methods.description: Returns the list of supported clipboard data types.
